analysis.title: Capitulation? The Setup For A Violent Market Squeeze
key_insights: SPX and NDX futures printed large hammer candles after testing support overnight. SPX futures came close to the 200-day moving average at the overnight lows and reclaimed the range in place since August.
SPX is roughly flat since May with no meaningful medium-term trend. Chasing momentum at range extremes has been a losing strategy, and trading SPX has required mean reversion.

NDX futures tested the major trend line and the 27,500 support level overnight, briefly undershooting the 200-day moving average before reclaiming it. The note says this could mark a capitulation low, at least for now.
October saw the largest monthly drop in global risk appetite since November 2021.

Morgan Stanley's Composite Sentiment Indicator is approaching the panic zone but has not reached the -2.00 reading that marks a textbook flush. The note argues markets do not necessarily need full capitulation to squeeze.

Goldman Sachs (Quinn) sees fresh S&P 500 futures shorts entering during the tech selloff. E-mini open interest rose $13.5bn and December funding cheapened by 3bps. It is unclear whether this is hedging or directional shorting, but fresh shorts into the lows could force an aggressive unwind.
AI semis are down 11.6% and hyperscalers down 6% since October 27, and selling may be spreading to broader index positioning.
JPMorgan notes that since 1990 the S&P 500 has averaged gains of 5.4%, 11.4%, 12.5% and 14.7% over the 3, 6, 9 and 12 months after US midterms, with a 100% positive hit rate at 6, 9 and 12 months.

JPMorgan says the recent de-risking is not quite capitulatory because quant selling and elevated tech positioning remain risks. Momentum exposure has fallen to about 30% of its peak, which it says may set up an alpha rebound.
The SOX forward P/E has fallen to 16x, an AI-cycle low. The note says a sharp multiple-driven rebound is possible if AI sentiment stabilizes.

BofA highlights IGV and SMH December call spreads as having some of the most attractive upside payout ratios among liquid ETFs. Clearing of midterm uncertainty could trigger a sharp recovery, and call spreads cap losses at the premium paid.
